question:
Which of the following letter clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

CMW, MWG, WGQ, GQA, ?
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern follows here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dbfaea079cafb0a56894bef0233fb91b37bb3237b75750c0e85b35d52201e04.png] 

Thus, 'QAK' will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
